ambient_change: Ambient conditions held stable during capture
transport: MQTT chunks; buffered acquisition, transmission after capture
sampling: CRC validated; channel counters reject duplicate polls. Color requires matching channel counters. Fast uses only illuminance CH1. Actual intervals recorded.
cct_method: Same coefficients and nearest Planckian locus calculation as original SD run; no specification normalization
restoration: Measurement capture completed; operational restoration details are excluded from this publication
observer_source: Sibling SD experiment source; CIE 1931 2-degree, 5nm integration, CIE1960 uv nearest Planckian locus at 1K steps; license retained.
absolute_sensor_color_accuracy: Not independently calibrated; 1K grid is not 1K accuracy
frequency_limit: Measured sample cadence sets Nyquist limit; integration and low-light quantization affect amplitude. No certified PstLM/SVM.
